npc:10278.text: I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.

npc:11833.text: Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.$B$BI deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

npc:246344.text: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

npc:277055.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, reshape tusks and horns, and even modify undead features!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

npc:2798.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

npc:2998.text: You have the look of a $g man : woman; who seeks knowledge. Perhaps you seek the teachings of the forge, and the hammer. Perhaps I can guide you down that path. But only once you have accepted the spirits, and listened to their calling.

npc:3030.text: May the spirits be with you.

npc:3031.text: May the spirits be with you.

npc:3032.text: May the spirits be with you.

npc:3033.text: Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.$B$BIt never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

npc:3034.text: $n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

npc:3036.text: $n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

npc:3047.text: Well met, $c.  My advice to you is this: as you travel the world, be wary of magic for it will burn the untrained.

npc:3084.text: The Thunder Bluff Bank can be found on the lower rise.

npc:5054.text: Our ancestors teach us that while the individual must be strong, there is safety in numbers.  Do you wish to defend the honor of Thunder Bluff by organizing a guild?

npc:5769.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

npc:5957.text: I do not believe you possess the mental acuity to grasp the nature of portal magic.

npc:9087.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

progress.text:
How goes your search for the Chasm? And the troggs?

The threat cannot be allowed to persist--it will only injure our orc brethren if it continues.

There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors.

Or it could be something else entirely.

Though the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.
